  WHY: The pop drops a real positional argument, so the explicit refspec is never validated.

  WHY: The test at line 207 expects `should_run == "true"`, so the `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` CI job fails.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:351-359 (_guarded_git_invocations) | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When the parser encounters `GIT_DIR+=appended` it stores `environment["GIT_DIR"] = "appended"` (the appended portion only, not the full joined path).
  WHY: The partial value can make `current_branch` fail silently and return an uncertain fallback target rather than the actual branch name.

  PROBLEM: When parsing environment variable assignments with `+=`, the trailing `+` is stripped from the name but only the appended substring is stored as its value.
  WHY: Git subprocesses can run with an incomplete `GIT_DIR` path and fail or target an incorrect repository directory.
